paragraphs.en: The online and offline costs answer different questions. Online latency is paid for every generated sample. Calibration, predictor fitting, and schedule search are one-time costs that can be amortized over later generations. We therefore report them separately.
paragraphs.zh: 在线成本与离线成本回答的是不同的问题。 在线延迟在每生成一个样本时都要支付一次。 校准、预测器拟合与调度搜索是一次性成本，可在后续生成中摊销。 因此我们将它们分开报告。

sents.en: The online and offline costs answer different questions.
sents.zh: 在线成本与离线成本回答的是不同的问题。

sents.en: Online latency is paid for every generated sample.
sents.zh: 在线延迟在每生成一个样本时都要支付一次。

sents.en: Calibration, predictor fitting, and schedule search are one-time costs that can be amortized over later generations.
sents.zh: 校准、预测器拟合与调度搜索是一次性成本，可在后续生成中摊销。

sents.en: We therefore report them separately.
sents.zh: 因此我们将它们分开报告。

paragraphs.en: The image benchmark uses one H100 per image and a batch size of one. Each model–method–ratio configuration uses the same 16 prompts at base seed 314159. The first four prompt indices are excluded as warm-up, and latency is the arithmetic mean over the other 12 prompt–seed runs. These are 12 different prompts. Timing includes prompt encoding, denoising, VAE decoding, and conversion to an image. It excludes model loading and image-file saving. GPU work is synchronized before and after the timed computation. Speedup divides the full-compute mean latency by the accelerated mean.
paragraphs.zh: 图像基准测试对每张图像使用一个 H100，批大小（batch size）为 1。 每个模型–方法–比例配置都使用相同的 16 个提示词，基础种子为 314159。 前四个提示词索引作为预热被排除，时延取其余 12 组提示词–种子运行结果的算术平均值。 这些是 12 个不同的提示词。 计时包括提示词编码、去噪、VAE 解码以及转换为图像。 它不包括模型加载和图像文件保存。 在计时计算的前后都对 GPU 工作进行了同步。 加速比以完整计算的平均时延除以加速后的平均时延得到。

sents.en: The image benchmark uses one H100 per image and a batch size of one.
sents.zh: 图像基准测试对每张图像使用一个 H100，批大小（batch size）为 1。

sents.en: Each model–method–ratio configuration uses the same 16 prompts at base seed 314159.
sents.zh: 每个模型–方法–比例配置都使用相同的 16 个提示词，基础种子为 314159。

sents.en: The first four prompt indices are excluded as warm-up, and latency is the arithmetic mean over the other 12 prompt–seed runs.
sents.zh: 前四个提示词索引作为预热被排除，时延取其余 12 组提示词–种子运行结果的算术平均值。

sents.en: These are 12 different prompts.
sents.zh: 这些是 12 个不同的提示词。

sents.en: Timing includes prompt encoding, denoising, VAE decoding, and conversion to an image.
sents.zh: 计时包括提示词编码、去噪、VAE 解码以及转换为图像。

sents.en: It excludes model loading and image-file saving.
sents.zh: 它不包括模型加载和图像文件保存。

sents.en: GPU work is synchronized before and after the timed computation.
sents.zh: 在计时计算的前后都对 GPU 工作进行了同步。

sents.en: Speedup divides the full-compute mean latency by the accelerated mean.
sents.zh: 加速比以完整计算的平均时延除以加速后的平均时延得到。

paragraphs.en: Video latency is measured during generation on H100 GPUs at batch size one. Each configuration generates one video for each prompt–seed run, giving 599 videos per Penguin599 base seed and 944 per VBench944 base seed. Timing includes prompt encoding, denoising, decoding, and output-file saving. It excludes model loading. The first video of each generation worker is excluded as warm-up. We average the retained per-video times within each dataset and base seed, then give the six dataset–seed means equal weight. The image and video timings therefore use different sample populations and timing boundaries. Tables 15 – 18 give the four online latency tables.
paragraphs.zh: 视频延迟是在 H100 GPU 上以批次大小 1 在生成过程中测量的。 每种配置在每次「提示词–种子」运行中生成一个视频，因此每个 Penguin599 基础种子得到 599 个视频，每个 VBench944 基础种子得到 944 个视频。 计时包括提示词编码、去噪、解码以及输出文件保存。 计时不包括模型加载。 每个生成工作进程的第一个视频作为预热，被排除在外。 我们对每个数据集和基础种子内保留的单视频时间取平均，然后对这六个「数据集–种子」均值赋予相同权重。 因此，图像与视频的计时使用不同的样本总体和计时边界。 表 15 至表 18 给出了四张在线延迟表。

sents.en: Video latency is measured during generation on H100 GPUs at batch size one.
sents.zh: 视频延迟是在 H100 GPU 上以批次大小 1 在生成过程中测量的。

sents.en: Each configuration generates one video for each prompt–seed run, giving 599 videos per Penguin599 base seed and 944 per VBench944 base seed.
sents.zh: 每种配置在每次「提示词–种子」运行中生成一个视频，因此每个 Penguin599 基础种子得到 599 个视频，每个 VBench944 基础种子得到 944 个视频。

sents.en: Timing includes prompt encoding, denoising, decoding, and output-file saving.
sents.zh: 计时包括提示词编码、去噪、解码以及输出文件保存。

sents.en: It excludes model loading.
sents.zh: 计时不包括模型加载。

sents.en: The first video of each generation worker is excluded as warm-up.
sents.zh: 每个生成工作进程的第一个视频作为预热，被排除在外。

sents.en: We average the retained per-video times within each dataset and base seed, then give the six dataset–seed means equal weight.
sents.zh: 我们对每个数据集和基础种子内保留的单视频时间取平均，然后对这六个「数据集–种子」均值赋予相同权重。

sents.en: The image and video timings therefore use different sample populations and timing boundaries.
sents.zh: 因此，图像与视频的计时使用不同的样本总体和计时边界。

sents.en: Tables 15 – 18 give the four online latency tables.
sents.zh: 表 15 至表 18 给出了四张在线延迟表。

paragraphs.en: Offline preparation is paid once per model. SeaCache, DiCache, TaylorSeer, and HiCache do not fit model-specific predictors. TeaCache uses published coefficients on FLUX.1-dev and requires no additional coefficient fitting there. BudCache runs the largest search. It evaluates 179 to 727 candidate schedules per cache count on the image models, which takes 0.19 to 1.65 H100 hours on FLUX.1-dev and 0.91 to 5.82 hours on Qwen-Image. On the video models it evaluates 162 to 446 schedules, which takes 4.8 to 18.3 RTX 6000 Pro GPU hours on HunyuanVideo and 1.4 to 8.2 H100 hours on Wan2.1. The other fitted methods are cheaper. SenCache, L2P, and MeanCache take 2.5 to 7.2 RTX 6000 Pro GPU hours on HunyuanVideo and 1.8 to 2.9 H100 hours on Wan2.1. Image calibration for these methods and DPCache uses 50 prompts. Comparable preparation times were recorded only for the video implementations. Calibrating adaptive methods to the target cache ratios is the largest offline cost for the evaluated video methods: 67.5 H100 hours for HunyuanVideo and 68.0 hours for Wan2.1. RTX 6000 Pro hours are not converted to H100 hours.
paragraphs.zh: 离线准备对每个模型只需支付一次。 SeaCache、DiCache、TaylorSeer 和 HiCache 不适用于模型特定的预测器。 TeaCache 在 FLUX.1-dev 上使用已发布的系数，无需额外的系数拟合。 BudCache 的搜索规模最大。 它在每个缓存数量下对图像模型评估 179 到 727 个候选调度，在 FLUX.1-dev 上耗时 0.19 到 1.65 H100 小时，在 Qwen-Image 上耗时 0.91 到 5.82 小时。 在视频模型上它评估 162 到 446 个调度，在 HunyuanVideo 上耗时 4.8 到 18.3 RTX 6000 Pro GPU 小时，在 Wan2.1 上耗时 1.4 到 8.2 H100 小时。 其他经过拟合的方法成本更低。 SenCache、L2P 和 MeanCache 在 HunyuanVideo 上耗时 2.5 到 7.2 RTX 6000 Pro GPU 小时，在 Wan2.1 上耗时 1.8 到 2.9 H100 小时。 这些方法以及 DPCache 的图像校准使用 50 条提示。 仅在视频实现上记录到了可比的准备时间。 将自适应方法校准到目标缓存比例是所评估视频方法最大的离线成本：HunyuanVideo 为 67.5 H100 小时，Wan2.1 为 68.0 小时。 RTX 6000 Pro 小时不换算为 H100 小时。

sents.en: Offline preparation is paid once per model.
sents.zh: 离线准备对每个模型只需支付一次。

sents.en: SeaCache, DiCache, TaylorSeer, and HiCache do not fit model-specific predictors.
sents.zh: SeaCache、DiCache、TaylorSeer 和 HiCache 不适用于模型特定的预测器。

sents.en: TeaCache uses published coefficients on FLUX.1-dev and requires no additional coefficient fitting there.
sents.zh: TeaCache 在 FLUX.1-dev 上使用已发布的系数，无需额外的系数拟合。

sents.en: BudCache runs the largest search.
sents.zh: BudCache 的搜索规模最大。

sents.en: It evaluates 179 to 727 candidate schedules per cache count on the image models, which takes 0.19 to 1.65 H100 hours on FLUX.1-dev and 0.91 to 5.82 hours on Qwen-Image.
sents.zh: 它在每个缓存数量下对图像模型评估 179 到 727 个候选调度，在 FLUX.1-dev 上耗时 0.19 到 1.65 H100 小时，在 Qwen-Image 上耗时 0.91 到 5.82 小时。

sents.en: On the video models it evaluates 162 to 446 schedules, which takes 4.8 to 18.3 RTX 6000 Pro GPU hours on HunyuanVideo and 1.4 to 8.2 H100 hours on Wan2.1.
sents.zh: 在视频模型上它评估 162 到 446 个调度，在 HunyuanVideo 上耗时 4.8 到 18.3 RTX 6000 Pro GPU 小时，在 Wan2.1 上耗时 1.4 到 8.2 H100 小时。

sents.en: The other fitted methods are cheaper.
sents.zh: 其他经过拟合的方法成本更低。

sents.en: SenCache, L2P, and MeanCache take 2.5 to 7.2 RTX 6000 Pro GPU hours on HunyuanVideo and 1.8 to 2.9 H100 hours on Wan2.1.
sents.zh: SenCache、L2P 和 MeanCache 在 HunyuanVideo 上耗时 2.5 到 7.2 RTX 6000 Pro GPU 小时，在 Wan2.1 上耗时 1.8 到 2.9 H100 小时。

sents.en: Image calibration for these methods and DPCache uses 50 prompts.
sents.zh: 这些方法以及 DPCache 的图像校准使用 50 条提示。

sents.en: Comparable preparation times were recorded only for the video implementations.
sents.zh: 仅在视频实现上记录到了可比的准备时间。

sents.en: Calibrating adaptive methods to the target cache ratios is the largest offline cost for the evaluated video methods: 67.5 H100 hours for HunyuanVideo and 68.0 hours for Wan2.1.
sents.zh: 将自适应方法校准到目标缓存比例是所评估视频方法最大的离线成本：HunyuanVideo 为 67.5 H100 小时，Wan2.1 为 68.0 小时。

sents.en: RTX 6000 Pro hours are not converted to H100 hours.
sents.zh: RTX 6000 Pro 小时不换算为 H100 小时。

paragraphs.en: The exhaustive schedule search of Appendix B.5 is far larger than any of these. It generated 5,483,016 cached images. At the 2.37 seconds per image measured for a fixed schedule with residual reuse at K = 41 K=41 on FLUX.1-dev in Table 15 , that is about 3,600 H100 hours.
paragraphs.zh: 附录 B.5 中的穷举调度搜索的规模远大于上述任何一项。 它生成了 5,483,016 张缓存图像。 按照表 15 中在 FLUX.1-dev 上 K = 41 K=41 时采用残差复用的固定调度所测得的每张图像 2.37 秒计算，这大约相当于 3,600 个 H100 小时。

sents.en: The exhaustive schedule search of Appendix B.5 is far larger than any of these.
sents.zh: 附录 B.5 中的穷举调度搜索的规模远大于上述任何一项。

sents.en: It generated 5,483,016 cached images.
sents.zh: 它生成了 5,483,016 张缓存图像。

sents.en: At the 2.37 seconds per image measured for a fixed schedule with residual reuse at K = 41 K=41 on FLUX.1-dev in Table 15 , that is about 3,600 H100 hours.
sents.zh: 按照表 15 中在 FLUX.1-dev 上 K = 41 K=41 时采用残差复用的固定调度所测得的每张图像 2.37 秒计算，这大约相当于 3,600 个 H100 小时。

paragraphs.en: The image study comprises 891,720 prompt–seed runs across 96 combinations of method, model, dataset, and cache ratio. The number of unique schedules ranges from 2 to 62 per combination, with a median of 11 across the 96 combinations. Across these 96 combinations, the fraction of runs using one of the three most frequent schedules has a median of 89.8% and a range of 40.7–100%. The same schedule is most frequent under all three seeds in 85 of the 96 image combinations.
paragraphs.zh: 图像研究共包含 891,720 次提示词–种子运行，涵盖方法、模型、数据集与缓存比率的 96 种组合。 每种组合的独特调度数从 2 到 62 不等，96 种组合的中位数为 11。 在这 96 种组合中，使用三种最常见调度之一的运行所占比例的中位数为 89.8%，范围为 40.7–100%。 在 96 种图像组合中，有 85 种组合在全部三个种子下最常出现的调度是同一个。

sents.en: The image study comprises 891,720 prompt–seed runs across 96 combinations of method, model, dataset, and cache ratio.
sents.zh: 图像研究共包含 891,720 次提示词–种子运行，涵盖方法、模型、数据集与缓存比率的 96 种组合。

sents.en: The number of unique schedules ranges from 2 to 62 per combination, with a median of 11 across the 96 combinations.
sents.zh: 每种组合的独特调度数从 2 到 62 不等，96 种组合的中位数为 11。

sents.en: Across these 96 combinations, the fraction of runs using one of the three most frequent schedules has a median of 89.8% and a range of 40.7–100%.
sents.zh: 在这 96 种组合中，使用三种最常见调度之一的运行所占比例的中位数为 89.8%，范围为 40.7–100%。

sents.en: The same schedule is most frequent under all three seeds in 85 of the 96 image combinations.
sents.zh: 在 96 种图像组合中，有 85 种组合在全部三个种子下最常出现的调度是同一个。

paragraphs.en: We compute schedule frequencies from the exact sequences of 50 full or cached decisions, combining the three base seeds within each model, dataset, cache ratio, and method. If schedule u u occurs on a fraction p ⁡ ( u ) p(u) of runs, the effective schedule count is exp [ − ∑ u p ( u ) log p ( u ) ] \exp[-\sum_{u}p(u)\log p(u)] . It is the number of equally frequent schedules with the same entropy. For example, if all observed schedules are equally frequent, their effective count equals their unique count.
paragraphs.zh: 我们基于50个完整决策或缓存决策的精确序列来计算调度频率，并在每个模型、数据集、缓存比例和方法内合并三个基础种子。 若调度 u u 在 p ⁡ ( u ) p(u) 比例的运行中出现，则有效调度数为 exp [ − ∑ u p ( u ) log p ( u ) ] \exp[-\sum_{u}p(u)\log p(u)]。 它是具有相同熵的等频调度的数量。 例如，若所有观测到的调度出现频率相同，则其有效数量等于其唯一数量。

sents.en: We compute schedule frequencies from the exact sequences of 50 full or cached decisions, combining the three base seeds within each model, dataset, cache ratio, and method.
sents.zh: 我们基于50个完整决策或缓存决策的精确序列来计算调度频率，并在每个模型、数据集、缓存比例和方法内合并三个基础种子。

sents.en: If schedule u u occurs on a fraction p ⁡ ( u ) p(u) of runs, the effective schedule count is exp [ − ∑ u p ( u ) log p ( u ) ] \exp[-\sum_{u}p(u)\log p(u)] .
sents.zh: 若调度 u u 在 p ⁡ ( u ) p(u) 比例的运行中出现，则有效调度数为 exp [ − ∑ u p ( u ) log p ( u ) ] \exp[-\sum_{u}p(u)\log p(u)]。

sents.en: It is the number of equally frequent schedules with the same entropy.
sents.zh: 它是具有相同熵的等频调度的数量。

sents.en: For example, if all observed schedules are equally frequent, their effective count equals their unique count.
sents.zh: 例如，若所有观测到的调度出现频率相同，则其有效数量等于其唯一数量。

paragraphs.en: The most frequent schedule of an image method is identical across all four image datasets in five of six model–ratio combinations for SeaCache. The counts are four of six for SenCache, two of six for TeaCache, and one of six for DiCache. On video, the same schedule is most frequent under all three base seeds in 46 of 48 model–method–dataset–ratio combinations. The two disagreements are TeaCache on HunyuanVideo VBench944 at cache ratio 0.58 and SenCache on Wan2.1 Penguin599 at cache ratio 0.74. Across the two video models, the most frequent schedules differ at 4 to 23 step positions. The two video datasets share the most frequent schedule in 18 of the 24 model–method–ratio combinations.
paragraphs.zh: 在六组模型–比例组合中的五组里，SeaCache 的图像方法最常出现的调度在全部四个图像数据集上是一致的。 SenCache 为六组中的四组，TeaCache 为六组中的两组，DiCache 为六组中的一组。 在视频上，48 个模型–方法–数据集–比例组合中有 46 个在全部三个基础种子下最常出现的调度是相同的。 两个不一致的情况分别是 HunyuanVideo VBench944 上缓存比例为 0.58 的 TeaCache，以及 Wan2.1 Penguin599 上缓存比例为 0.74 的 SenCache。 在两个视频模型之间，最常出现的调度在 4 到 23 个步骤位置上有所不同。 在 24 个模型–方法–比例组合中，两个视频数据集共享相同的最常出现调度的有 18 个。

sents.en: The most frequent schedule of an image method is identical across all four image datasets in five of six model–ratio combinations for SeaCache.
sents.zh: 在六组模型–比例组合中的五组里，SeaCache 的图像方法最常出现的调度在全部四个图像数据集上是一致的。

sents.en: The counts are four of six for SenCache, two of six for TeaCache, and one of six for DiCache.
sents.zh: SenCache 为六组中的四组，TeaCache 为六组中的两组，DiCache 为六组中的一组。

sents.en: On video, the same schedule is most frequent under all three base seeds in 46 of 48 model–method–dataset–ratio combinations.
sents.zh: 在视频上，48 个模型–方法–数据集–比例组合中有 46 个在全部三个基础种子下最常出现的调度是相同的。

sents.en: The two disagreements are TeaCache on HunyuanVideo VBench944 at cache ratio 0.58 and SenCache on Wan2.1 Penguin599 at cache ratio 0.74.
sents.zh: 两个不一致的情况分别是 HunyuanVideo VBench944 上缓存比例为 0.58 的 TeaCache，以及 Wan2.1 Penguin599 上缓存比例为 0.74 的 SenCache。

sents.en: Across the two video models, the most frequent schedules differ at 4 to 23 step positions.
sents.zh: 在两个视频模型之间，最常出现的调度在 4 到 23 个步骤位置上有所不同。

paragraphs.en: Each method contributes 222,930 prompt–seed runs across 24 combinations. The schedule-reuse experiment in Section 3.1 evaluates each method’s most frequent schedule on new prompts.

paragraphs.en: We compare SeaCache, TeaCache, SenCache, and DiCache with fixed reuse of their most frequent schedules. Each model–method–ratio combination uses 1,632 prompts under three seeds, giving 4,896 prompt–seed runs. We select the most frequent schedule on 544 prompts and evaluate its reuse on the remaining 1,088 prompts. For each run, we subtract the adaptive output’s PSNR from the PSNR of the output generated with the fixed schedule and the same approximation policy. Runs with identical schedules have zero difference, so the results below use only runs where the two schedules differ.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 SeaCache、TeaCache、SenCache 和 DiCache 在其最常复用时间表的固定复用下进行比较。 每个模型–方法–比例组合在三个随机种子下使用 1,632 个提示，共得到 4,896 个提示–种子运行。 我们在 544 个提示上选出最常出现的时间表，并在其余 1,088 个提示上评估其复用效果。 对于每次运行，我们用固定时间表和相同近似策略生成的输出的 PSNR 减去自适应输出的 PSNR。 时间表相同的运行的差值为零，因此下述结果仅使用两个时间表不同的运行。

sents.zh: 我们将 SeaCache、TeaCache、SenCache 和 DiCache 在其最常复用时间表的固定复用下进行比较。

paragraphs.en: We first report mean quality changes across the 24 model–method–ratio combinations. Using all prompts gives 54 to 4,313 retained runs per combination. The mean PSNR differences range from − 0.79 -0.79 to + 1.60 +1.60 dB, where positive values favor the fixed schedule. The median absolute difference in mean PSNR is 0.09 dB. Restricting evaluation to the 1,088 prompts excluded from selection gives 34 to 2,901 retained runs per combination. On these prompts, the mean PSNR differences range from − 0.81 -0.81 to + 1.56 +1.56 dB, with a median absolute difference in mean PSNR of 0.10 dB.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先报告 24 种模型–方法–比例组合的平均质量变化。 使用全部提示时，每个组合保留的运行数为 54 至 4,313 个。 平均 PSNR 差异范围为 − 0.79 -0.79 至 + 1.60 +1.60 dB，其中正值表示固定调度更优。 平均 PSNR 差异的绝对值中位数为 0.09 dB。 将评估限制在未用于选择的 1,088 个提示时，每个组合保留的运行数为 34 至 2,901 个。 在这些提示上，平均 PSNR 差异范围为 − 0.81 -0.81 至 + 1.56 +1.56 dB，平均 PSNR 差异的绝对值中位数为 0.10 dB。

paragraphs.en: Table 20 gives 95% confidence intervals for the mean PSNR differences on prompts excluded from selection. We first average each prompt’s PSNR differences over the seeds where its adaptive and fixed schedules differ, then resample prompts 20,000 times. Each resampled mean weights a prompt by its number of retained runs, matching the reported mean paired difference. The interval spans the 2.5th to 97.5th percentiles of these resampled means. Twenty-two of the 24 intervals exclude zero. The two that do not are Qwen-Image DiCache at K = 29 K=29 and Qwen-Image SeaCache at K = 37 K=37 , the latter containing 34 runs.
paragraphs.zh: 表20给出了在未参与选择的经验证提示词上平均PSNR差值的95%置信区间。 我们先对每个提示词在自适应调度与固定调度不同的种子上求其PSNR差值的平均值，然后对提示词进行20,000次重采样。 每个重采样均值按提示词保留的运行次数对其进行加权，与所报告的平均配对差值一致。 该区间涵盖这些重采样均值的第2.5至97.5百分位数。 24个区间中有22个不包含零。 不包含零的两个是K = 29 K=29 下的Qwen-Image DiCache和K = 37 K=37 下的Qwen-Image SeaCache，后者包含34次运行。

paragraphs.en: The lower block of Table 20 replaces the fixed schedule with a random schedule of the same K K , on the same held-out runs where the fixed and adaptive schedules differ. We draw each random schedule’s K K cached steps uniformly without replacement from steps 3–48, leaving steps 0, 1, 2, and 49 full. Each random schedule uses the approximation policy of the method it is compared against: residual reuse for SeaCache, SenCache, and TeaCache, and the two-anchor extrapolation for DiCache. There are five draws per model at K = 29 K=29 and K = 37 K=37 and two at K = 41 K=41 . The first two draws at each cache count use three seeds. The remaining draws at K = 29 K=29 and K = 37 K=37 use only base seed 42. For each paired run, we subtract the adaptive output’s PSNR from the random schedule output’s PSNR. We report the median of these differences across draws, models, cache counts, available seeds, and evaluation prompts where the adaptive and fixed schedules differ. A prompt can contribute to several draws and seeds. The median paired PSNR difference is negative for SeaCache, SenCache, and DiCache. For TeaCache, the random schedules have higher PSNR but lower SSIM and higher LPIPS than the adaptive schedules.
paragraphs.zh: 表20的下半部分在固定调度与自适应调度不同的同一批留存运行上，用相同 K K 的随机调度替换固定调度。 我们从第3步到第48步中不放回地均匀抽取每个随机调度的 K K 个缓存步，第0、1、2和49步保持完整。 每个随机调度使用其对比方法所采用的近似策略：SeaCache、SenCache 和 TeaCache 使用残差复用，DiCache 使用双锚点外推。 每个模型在 K = 29 K=29 和 K = 37 K=37 时各有五次抽取，在 K = 41 K=41 时有两次抽取。 每个缓存数量的前两次抽取使用三个种子。 K = 29 K=29 和 K = 37 K=37 时其余的抽取仅使用基础种子42。 对于每一组配对运行，我们用随机调度输出的 PSNR 减去自适应输出的 PSNR。 我们报告这些差异在自适应调度与固定调度不同的所有抽取、模型、缓存数量、可用种子和评估提示上的中位数。 一个提示可以对多次抽取和多个种子有所贡献。 SeaCache、SenCache 和 DiCache 的配对 PSNR 差异中位数为负。 对于 TeaCache，随机调度比自适应调度具有更高的 PSNR，但更低的 SSIM 和更高的 LPIPS。

paragraphs.en: The video comparison covers the same four methods. Each comparison contains 150 prompts from each of Penguin599 and VBench944, with one seed per prompt. Both models use the first 150 prompts in each dataset’s evaluation list, ordered by the SHA-256 hash of the prompt text. For Penguin599, we apply Unicode NFKC normalization, lowercase the text, remove leading and trailing whitespace, and replace internal runs of whitespace with a single space before hashing. For VBench944, we hash the original text. Both use UTF-8 encoding. Generation uses the original prompt text.
paragraphs.zh: 视频对比涵盖相同的四种方法。 每个对比包含来自 Penguin599 和 VBench944 各 150 条提示词，每条提示词使用一个种子。 两个模型均使用各数据集评估列表中的前 150 条提示词，并按提示词文本的 SHA-256 哈希值排序。 对于 Penguin599，我们在哈希前先进行 Unicode NFKC 规范化，将文本转为小写，去除首尾空白，并将内部的连续空白替换为单个空格。 对于 VBench944，我们对原始文本进行哈希。两者均使用 UTF-8 编码。 生成时使用原始提示词文本。

paragraphs.en: For each model, method, and target cache ratio, we combine schedule counts from both datasets and all three base seeds, counting each prompt–seed run once. We choose the most frequent schedule with exactly K K cached steps. If no schedule has that cache count, we choose the most frequent schedule across all cache counts. Restricting selection to prompts outside the 300 evaluation prompts, excluding those prompts under all three seeds, gives the same schedule in all 24 model–method–ratio combinations. Of the 24 model–method–ratio combinations, three have a fixed schedule whose cache count differs from the target. In two other combinations, the adaptive method already follows the fixed schedule on every evaluation prompt. Table 22 separates these groups. We compare mean PSNR on prompts with different schedules in the remaining 19 combinations. The fixed schedule’s mean PSNR is at most 0.25 dB lower than the adaptive method’s in 17 of them. The two exceptions are SenCache on HunyuanVideo at ratio 0.58 and SenCache on HunyuanVideo at ratio 0.82. Table 23 gives the Penguin599 and VBench944 results separately.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个模型、方法和目标缓存比例，我们合并来自两个数据集和全部三个基础随机种子的调度计数，每个提示词–种子运行只计一次。 我们选择恰好有 K K 个缓存步骤的最高频调度。 如果没有调度具有该缓存数量，我们选择在所有缓存数量中最高频的调度。 将选择范围限制在 300 个评估提示词之外、在全部三个种子下都排除这些提示词时，在全部 24 种模型–方法–比例组合中得到相同的调度。 在 24 种模型–方法–比例组合中，有三种组合的固定调度其缓存数量与目标不同。 在另外两种组合中，自适应方法在所有评估提示词上已经遵循该固定调度。 表 22 对这些组进行了区分。 我们在其余 19 种组合中比较不同调度提示词上的平均 PSNR。 在其中 17 种组合中，固定调度的平均 PSNR 比自适应方法低至多 0.25 dB。 两个例外是 SenCache 在 HunyuanVideo 上比例为 0.58 的情况，以及 SenCache 在 HunyuanVideo 上比例为 0.82 的情况。 表 23 分别给出了 Penguin599 和 VBench944 的结果。

sents.en: For each model, method, and target cache ratio, we combine schedule counts from both datasets and all three base seeds, counting each prompt–seed run once.
sents.zh: 对于每个模型、方法和目标缓存比例，我们合并来自两个数据集和全部三个基础随机种子的调度计数，每个提示词–种子运行只计一次。

sents.en: We choose the most frequent schedule with exactly K K cached steps.
sents.zh: 我们选择恰好有 K K 个缓存步骤的最高频调度。

sents.en: If no schedule has that cache count, we choose the most frequent schedule across all cache counts.
sents.zh: 如果没有调度具有该缓存数量，我们选择在所有缓存数量中最高频的调度。

sents.en: Restricting selection to prompts outside the 300 evaluation prompts, excluding those prompts under all three seeds, gives the same schedule in all 24 model–method–ratio combinations.
sents.zh: 将选择范围限制在 300 个评估提示词之外、在全部三个种子下都排除这些提示词时，在全部 24 种模型–方法–比例组合中得到相同的调度。

sents.en: Of the 24 model–method–ratio combinations, three have a fixed schedule whose cache count differs from the target.
sents.zh: 在 24 种模型–方法–比例组合中，有三种组合的固定调度其缓存数量与目标不同。

sents.en: In two other combinations, the adaptive method already follows the fixed schedule on every evaluation prompt.
sents.zh: 在另外两种组合中，自适应方法在所有评估提示词上已经遵循该固定调度。

sents.en: Table 22 separates these groups.
sents.zh: 表 22 对这些组进行了区分。

sents.en: We compare mean PSNR on prompts with different schedules in the remaining 19 combinations.
sents.zh: 我们在其余 19 种组合中比较不同调度提示词上的平均 PSNR。

sents.en: The fixed schedule’s mean PSNR is at most 0.25 dB lower than the adaptive method’s in 17 of them.
sents.zh: 在其中 17 种组合中，固定调度的平均 PSNR 比自适应方法低至多 0.25 dB。

sents.en: The two exceptions are SenCache on HunyuanVideo at ratio 0.58 and SenCache on HunyuanVideo at ratio 0.82.
sents.zh: 两个例外是 SenCache 在 HunyuanVideo 上比例为 0.58 的情况，以及 SenCache 在 HunyuanVideo 上比例为 0.82 的情况。

sents.en: Table 23 gives the Penguin599 and VBench944 results separately.
sents.zh: 表 23 分别给出了 Penguin599 和 VBench944 的结果。

paragraphs.en: The video random control uses uniformly sampled schedules with the same cache ratio and residual-reuse approximation policy. For each model and cache ratio, we draw two schedules by sampling the K K cached steps uniformly without replacement from steps 3–48. Steps 0, 1, 2, and 49 remain full. We compare them with SeaCache, TeaCache, and SenCache on both video models. For each paired run, we subtract the adaptive output’s PSNR from the random-schedule output’s PSNR. For each model and method, we take the median of these differences across random draws, cache ratios, dataset-specific base seeds, and prompts. A prompt can contribute to several draws and cache ratios. The six medians range from − 5.9 -5.9 to − 0.3 -0.3 dB, favoring the adaptive methods. DiCache is excluded because its adaptive run uses two-anchor prediction rather than residual reuse.
paragraphs.zh: 视频随机对照实验采用均匀采样的调度，并使用相同的缓存比例与残差复用近似策略。 对于每个模型和缓存比例，我们通过从第 3–48 步中无放回地均匀采样 K K 个缓存步，抽取两个调度。 第 0、1、2 和 49 步保持完整计算。 我们在两个视频模型上将它们与 SeaCache、TeaCache 和 SenCache 进行比较。 对于每组配对实验，我们用随机调度的输出的 PSNR 减去自适应输出的 PSNR。 对于每个模型和方法，我们取这些差值在随机抽取、缓存比例、特定数据集的基础种子以及提示词上的中位数。 一个提示词可以贡献到多次抽取和多个缓存比例。 这六个中位数的范围从 − 5.9 -5.9 到 − 0.3 -0.3 dB，均有利于自适应方法。 DiCache 被排除在外，因为其自适应运行使用双锚点预测而非残差复用。

sents.en: Steps 0, 1, 2, and 49 remain full.
sents.zh: 第 0、1、2 和 49 步保持完整计算。

sents.en: We compare them with SeaCache, TeaCache, and SenCache on both video models.
sents.zh: 我们在两个视频模型上将它们与 SeaCache、TeaCache 和 SenCache 进行比较。

sents.en: For each paired run, we subtract the adaptive output’s PSNR from the random-schedule output’s PSNR.
sents.zh: 对于每组配对实验，我们用随机调度的输出的 PSNR 减去自适应输出的 PSNR。

sents.en: For each model and method, we take the median of these differences across random draws, cache ratios, dataset-specific base seeds, and prompts.
sents.zh: 对于每个模型和方法，我们取这些差值在随机抽取、缓存比例、特定数据集的基础种子以及提示词上的中位数。

sents.en: A prompt can contribute to several draws and cache ratios.
sents.zh: 一个提示词可以贡献到多次抽取和多个缓存比例。

sents.en: The six medians range from − 5.9 -5.9 to − 0.3 -0.3 dB, favoring the adaptive methods.
sents.zh: 这六个中位数的范围从 − 5.9 -5.9 到 − 0.3 -0.3 dB，均有利于自适应方法。

sents.en: DiCache is excluded because its adaptive run uses two-anchor prediction rather than residual reuse.
sents.zh: DiCache 被排除在外，因为其自适应运行使用双锚点预测而非残差复用。

paragraphs.en: A prompt’s best evaluated result depends on the schedules in its candidate set. We compare two candidate sets to examine how this choice affects coverage. The smaller sets contain 9–17 schedules from offline search methods, uniform spacing, frequent adaptive choices, and variants of the MeanCache schedule. The enlarged sets contain every available distinct schedule at the same cache ratio under residual reuse, including further MeanCache variants and random schedules. They contain 13–32 schedules. Section 3 summarizes the coverage results for these enlarged sets. Within each set, we compare a fixed schedule’s quality with the highest quality reached by any candidate on the same prompt.
paragraphs.zh: 一个提示词的最佳评估结果取决于其候选集中的调度方案。 我们比较两个候选集，以考察这一选择如何影响覆盖率。 较小的候选集包含 9–17 个调度方案，来自离线搜索方法、均匀间隔、频繁的自适应选择以及 MeanCache 调度方案的变体。 扩大的候选集包含在残差复用下相同缓存比例下所有可用的不同调度方案，包括更多的 MeanCache 变体和随机调度方案。 它们包含 13–32 个调度方案。 第 3 节总结了这些扩大候选集的覆盖率结果。 在每个候选集内，我们将固定调度方案的质量与同一提示词上任何候选方案达到的最高质量进行比较。

sents.en: A prompt’s best evaluated result depends on the schedules in its candidate set.
sents.zh: 一个提示词的最佳评估结果取决于其候选集中的调度方案。

sents.en: We compare two candidate sets to examine how this choice affects coverage.
sents.zh: 我们比较两个候选集，以考察这一选择如何影响覆盖率。

sents.en: The smaller sets contain 9–17 schedules from offline search methods, uniform spacing, frequent adaptive choices, and variants of the MeanCache schedule.
sents.zh: 较小的候选集包含 9–17 个调度方案，来自离线搜索方法、均匀间隔、频繁的自适应选择以及 MeanCache 调度方案的变体。

sents.en: The enlarged sets contain every available distinct schedule at the same cache ratio under residual reuse, including further MeanCache variants and random schedules.
sents.zh: 扩大的候选集包含在残差复用下相同缓存比例下所有可用的不同调度方案，包括更多的 MeanCache 变体和随机调度方案。

sents.en: They contain 13–32 schedules.
sents.zh: 它们包含 13–32 个调度方案。

sents.en: Section 3 summarizes the coverage results for these enlarged sets.
sents.zh: 第 3 节总结了这些扩大候选集的覆盖率结果。

sents.en: Within each set, we compare a fixed schedule’s quality with the highest quality reached by any candidate on the same prompt.
sents.zh: 在每个候选集内，我们将固定调度方案的质量与同一提示词上任何候选方案达到的最高质量进行比较。

paragraphs.en: For the image coverage tests, we construct variants of the MeanCache schedule by exchanging one, two, or four cached steps with full steps while preserving the cache count. For each available swap count, the first variant restricts every exchanged position to steps after the first cached step and is evaluated under three seeds. Further variants at cache ratios 0.58 and 0.74 use base seed 42, with swaps either restricted in this way or allowed throughout steps 3–48. The coverage tests include the variants with available quality measurements.
paragraphs.zh: 在图像覆盖率测试中，我们通过将一个、两个或四个缓存步替换为完整步，同时保持缓存步数量不变，来构建 MeanCache 调度的变体。 对于每个可用的交换数量，第一个变体将每个交换位置限制在第一个缓存步之后的步上，并在三个随机种子下进行评估。 缓存比率为 0.58 和 0.74 的进一步变体使用基础种子 42，其交换要么按此方式受限，要么允许在步骤 3–48 中任意进行。 覆盖率测试包括具有可用质量测量的变体。

sents.en: For the image coverage tests, we construct variants of the MeanCache schedule by exchanging one, two, or four cached steps with full steps while preserving the cache count.
sents.zh: 在图像覆盖率测试中，我们通过将一个、两个或四个缓存步替换为完整步，同时保持缓存步数量不变，来构建 MeanCache 调度的变体。

sents.en: The coverage tests include the variants with available quality measurements.
sents.zh: 覆盖率测试包括具有可用质量测量的变体。

The fixed-budget space is 𝒮 K = { u ∈ { 0 , 1 } N : ‖ u ‖ 0 = K } \mathcal{S}_{K}=\{u\in\{0,1\}^{N}:\left\lVert u\right\rVert_{0}=K\} . Each experiment specifies any required full steps within this space.

paragraphs.en: For each image prompt and schedule, we average scores over the available base seeds. Most configurations use three base seeds. Additional MeanCache variants and random draws use only base seed 42, as described above and in Appendix B.2 . We also evaluate all image schedules at their common base seed 42 below. Video scores use one seed per prompt throughout each candidate set.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个图像提示词和调度方案，我们在可用的基础种子上取平均分数。 大多数配置使用三个基础种子。 其他 MeanCache 变体和随机抽取仅使用基础种子 42，如上文和附录 B.2 所述。 我们还在下文于它们共同的基础种子 42 上评估所有图像调度方案。 视频分数在每个候选集合中对每个提示词全程使用一个种子。

sents.en: For each image prompt and schedule, we average scores over the available base seeds.
sents.zh: 对于每个图像提示词和调度方案，我们在可用的基础种子上取平均分数。

sents.en: Most configurations use three base seeds.
sents.zh: 大多数配置使用三个基础种子。

sents.en: Additional MeanCache variants and random draws use only base seed 42, as described above and in Appendix B.2 .
sents.zh: 其他 MeanCache 变体和随机抽取仅使用基础种子 42，如上文和附录 B.2 所述。

sents.en: We also evaluate all image schedules at their common base seed 42 below.
sents.zh: 我们还在下文于它们共同的基础种子 42 上评估所有图像调度方案。

sents.en: Video scores use one seed per prompt throughout each candidate set.
sents.zh: 视频分数在每个候选集合中对每个提示词全程使用一个种子。

paragraphs.en: For each candidate set, we select the schedule with the highest coverage at 0.25 dB and report that same schedule at all three margins. We repeat this selection for the enlarged set. To account for selecting among m m schedules, we compute a one-sided binomial lower confidence bound at the Bonferroni level 0.05 / m 0.05/m . At each margin, we count the model–ratio combinations whose corrected lower bound on coverage exceeds 0.5.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个候选集合，我们选择在 0.25 dB 下覆盖度最高的调度，并在所有三个余量下报告同一调度。 我们对扩大后的集合重复这一选择。 为了考虑在 m 个调度中进行选择的情况，我们在 Bonferroni 水平 0.05 / m 下计算单侧二项式置信下界。 在每个余量下，我们统计修正后的覆盖度置信下界超过 0.5 的模型–比值组合的数量。

sents.en: For each candidate set, we select the schedule with the highest coverage at 0.25 dB and report that same schedule at all three margins.
sents.zh: 对于每个候选集合，我们选择在 0.25 dB 下覆盖度最高的调度，并在所有三个余量下报告同一调度。

sents.zh: 我们对扩大后的集合重复这一选择。

paragraphs.en: For the smaller candidate sets, Table 25 reports 12 model–ratio combinations, six image and six video. All twelve corrected bounds exceed 0.5 at the 0.5 dB margin, the lowest being 0.529. Eight of the twelve pass at the 0.25 dB margin under the same correction. Random schedules of the same K K reach at most 6% of prompts at 0.25 dB.
paragraphs.zh: 对于较小的候选集，表 25 报告了 12 种模型–比例组合，其中六种为图像、六种为视频。 在 0.5 dB 裕度下，全部 12 个经校正的界都超过 0.5，最低为 0.529。 在同样的校正下，12 个中有 8 个在 0.25 dB 裕度下通过。 相同 K 的随机调度在 0.25 dB 下最多达到 6% 的提示词。

sents.en: For the smaller candidate sets, Table 25 reports 12 model–ratio combinations, six image and six video.
sents.zh: 对于较小的候选集，表 25 报告了 12 种模型–比例组合，其中六种为图像、六种为视频。

sents.en: All twelve corrected bounds exceed 0.5 at the 0.5 dB margin, the lowest being 0.529.
sents.zh: 在 0.5 dB 裕度下，全部 12 个经校正的界都超过 0.5，最低为 0.529。

sents.en: Eight of the twelve pass at the 0.25 dB margin under the same correction.

sents.zh: 相同 K 的随机调度在 0.25 dB 下最多达到 6% 的提示词。

paragraphs.en: The enlarged candidate sets provide a stronger per-prompt reference. Under the same correction, the lower bound exceeds 0.5 in 7 of 12 combinations at 0.25 dB, 9 of 12 at 0.5 dB, and all 12 at 1.0 dB. These are the enlarged-set results summarized in Section 3 . The separate 337-schedule comparison in Appendix B.5 examines FLUX.1-dev at cache ratio 0.82 on 2,381 new prompts. One schedule stays within 0.5 dB of each prompt’s best candidate on 62% of these prompts. The schedule selected from four scoring runs reaches 57%.
paragraphs.zh: 扩大的候选集为每个提示提供了更强的参考基准。 在相同修正下，下界在 0.25 dB 时于 12 种组合中的 7 种超过 0.5，在 0.5 dB 时为 12 种中的 9 种，在 1.0 dB 时全部 12 种均超过 0.5。 这些是第 3 节中总结的扩大候选集的结果。 附录 B.5 中单独的 337 调度比较在 2,381 个新提示上考察了缓存比率为 0.82 的 FLUX.1-dev。 其中一个调度在 62% 的提示上与每个提示的最佳候选相差不超过 0.5 dB。 从四次评分运行中选出的调度达到了 57%。

sents.zh: 扩大的候选集为每个提示提供了更强的参考基准。

paragraphs.en: To compare all image schedules under the same seed, we repeat the enlarged-set analysis at base seed 42 in Table 24 . We again select one schedule at the 0.25 dB margin before reporting all three margins. Each of the six reported schedules stays within 0.5 dB of its candidate set’s per-prompt best on a majority of prompts, including after correcting the lower bounds for candidate set size.
paragraphs.zh: 为了在同一随机种子下比较所有图像调度方案，我们在表24中以基础种子42重复了扩充集分析。 我们再次在0.25 dB容差下选择一个调度方案，然后报告全部三个容差。 六个所报告的调度方案中，每一个都在大多数提示上保持在其候选集的逐提示最优结果0.5 dB以内，包括在对候选集规模的下界进行校正之后。

sents.en: To compare all image schedules under the same seed, we repeat the enlarged-set analysis at base seed 42 in Table 24 .

sents.en: Each of the six reported schedules stays within 0.5 dB of its candidate set’s per-prompt best on a majority of prompts, including after correcting the lower bounds for candidate set size.
sents.zh: 六个所报告的调度方案中，每一个都在大多数提示上保持在其候选集的逐提示最优结果0.5 dB以内，包括在对候选集规模的下界进行校正之后。

paragraphs.en: To interpret the PSNR margins in Table 25 , we compare them with the quality change across cache ratios for the schedules from BudCache, DPCache, MeanCache, and uniform spacing. For each schedule, image model, and ratio, we average PSNR over the available seeds within each prompt and take the median across the 1,088 held-out PartiPrompts prompts. We subtract the higher-ratio median from the lower-ratio median. Adjacent ratios differ by 8 and by 4 cached steps, so we divide each drop by the number of additional cached steps. This gives the average quality change per additional cached step between the tested ratios. There are 16 values, four schedules by two ratio pairs by two models. They run from 0.171 to 1.166 dB, with a median of 0.592 dB. The margins are 0.25, 0.5, and 1.0 dB. These are 0.42, 0.84, and 1.69 times that median.
paragraphs.zh: 为了解读表25中的PSNR差距，我们将其与BudCache、DPCache、MeanCache和均匀间隔这几组调度在不同缓存比例下的质量变化进行比较。 对于每个调度、图像模型和比例，我们先在每个提示内对可用种子的PSNR取平均，再在1,088个留出的PartiPrompts提示上取中位数。 我们用较低比例的中位数减去较高比例的中位数。 相邻比例之间相差8个和4个缓存步，因此我们将每个下降值除以新增的缓存步数。 这样就得到所测比例之间每增加一个缓存步的平均质量变化。 共有16个数值，即四个调度乘以两组比例对再乘以两个模型。 这些数值从0.171到1.166 dB不等，中位数为0.592 dB。 差距阈值设为0.25、0.5和1.0 dB。 它们分别是该中位数的0.42倍、0.84倍和1.69倍。

paragraphs.en: The coverage test in Table 25 uses PSNR to measure quality. We repeat the test with SSIM and LPIPS, using the same candidate sets and prompts. Each measure needs its own margins. On the same four schedules, we take the median of seed-averaged prompt quality over the same 1,088 held-out prompts at each cache ratio. We divide the SSIM decrease or LPIPS increase between adjacent tested ratios by the number of additional cached steps. There are again 16 values. For SSIM they run from 0.0054 to 0.0367, with a median of 0.0138. For LPIPS they run from 0.0080 to 0.0495, with a median of 0.0202. For each metric, the three margins are about one half, one, and two times its median change per additional cached step. LPIPS is smaller when quality is better, so we negate it before the test and state its margins as positive LPIPS differences. Table 26 gives the result.
paragraphs.zh: 表 25 中的覆盖率测试使用 PSNR 来衡量质量。 我们使用 SSIM 和 LPIPS 重复该测试，并采用相同的候选集与提示词。 每种指标都需要各自的阈值。 在同样的四个调度方案上，我们在每个缓存比例下对相同的 1,088 个留出提示词取种子平均提示词质量的中位数。 我们将相邻被测比例之间的 SSIM 下降量或 LPIPS 上升量除以额外增加的缓存步数。 同样得到 16 个数值。 对于 SSIM，这些数值从 0.0054 到 0.0367，中位数为 0.0138。 对于 LPIPS，这些数值从 0.0080 到 0.0495，中位数为 0.0202。 对于每个指标，这三个阈值分别约为其每增加一个缓存步的中位变化量的 0.5 倍、1 倍和 2 倍。 LPIPS 在质量更好时数值更小，因此我们在测试前对其取负，并将其阈值表述为正的 LPIPS 差值。 表 26 给出了结果。

paragraphs.en: After the same candidate-count correction, all 12 SSIM bounds exceed 0.5 at the middle margin, the lowest being 0.521, and seven of the twelve do so at the tightest margin. Under LPIPS, 10 of the 12 corrected bounds exceed 0.5 at the middle margin, and eight do so at the tightest margin. At the middle margin, HunyuanVideo has corrected bounds of 0.477 at K = 37 K=37 and 0.481 at K = 41 K=41 . At the tightest margins, the best random schedules have higher coverage under SSIM and LPIPS than under PSNR. The best random schedule under SSIM covers 0.118 of the image prompts and 0.117 of the video prompts. Under LPIPS the two shares are 0.132 and 0.087. Under PSNR they are 0.057 and 0.020.

paragraphs.en: For the larger evaluation, we select the top 64 schedules by four-run mean PSNR, the top 64 by minimum PSNR, and the top 16 by mean PSNR for every subset of one, two, or three scoring runs. We also sample 128 distinct schedules uniformly from the full search space using seed 20270826 and include 11 existing or constructed controls. Combining these candidates and removing duplicates yields 337 distinct schedules. The 11 controls include the BudCache, MeanCache, and DPCache schedules, DiCache’s most frequent schedule with 41 cached steps, and a schedule with additional full steps at 3, 14, 25, 37, and 48. The other six are two MeanCache variants formed by exchanging one or two cached steps with full steps, two previously sampled random schedules, and two schedules constructed from full-compute trajectory measurements. The last two have full steps at 0, 1, 2, 4, 17, 31, 41, 46, 49 and at 0, 1, 2, 17, 28, 36, 42, 46, 49, respectively.
paragraphs.zh: 对于更大规模的评估，我们按四次运行的平均 PSNR 选出前 64 个时间表，按最小 PSNR 选出前 64 个，并且针对一次、两次或三次评分运行的每个子集按平均 PSNR 各选出前 16 个。 我们还使用种子 20270826 从完整搜索空间中均匀采样 128 个不同的时间表，并纳入 11 个已有或构造的对照。 合并这些候选并去除重复后，得到 337 个不同的时间表。 这 11 个对照包括 BudCache、MeanCache 和 DPCache 时间表，DiCache 最常见的时间表（缓存 41 步），以及在 3、14、25、37 和 48 处增加完整步骤的时间表。 其余六个是两个通过将一个或两个缓存步骤替换为完整步骤而形成的 MeanCache 变体，两个此前采样的随机时间表，以及两个由全计算轨迹测量构造的时间表。 最后两个分别在 0、1、2、4、17、31、41、46、49 处，以及在 0、1、2、17、28、36、42、46、49 处设有完整步骤。

paragraphs.en: The two selected schedules, the MeanCache and BudCache schedules, and the adaptive methods are evaluated on the data in Table 28 . paragraphs.en: Two-anchor prediction evaluates the first transformer block at each cached step. Its quality gains therefore come with more computation than residual reuse. The corresponding differences across approximation policies are 3.963 dB on the three smaller datasets and 3.508 dB on DiffusionDB. paragraphs.en: The stored image trajectory states use BF16. To estimate the rounding floor, we replace each three-state window’s middle state by the exact midpoint of its endpoints in FP64, round it to BF16, and measure the resulting angle. The signal-to-floor ratio divides the median measured angle by this median rounding-induced angle at the same step. A one-step angle is too small to separate reliably from rounding, so Equation 2 uses a multi-step window. For FLUX, w = 5 w=5 produces a signal-to-rounding-floor ratio of 3.42–25.5 over the complete trajectory. Qwen-Image is straighter in the middle. Its minimum ratio at w = 5 w=5 is 2.61. On a subset of 30 Qwen-Image trajectories, increasing the window gives minimum ratios 3.76, 5.13, and 6.54 for w = 7 , 9 , 11 w=7,9,11 . The profiles across datasets use w = 5 w=5 . The measurements at w ≥ 7 w\geq 7 assess numerical precision on the 30-trajectory subset.

paragraphs.en: We next compare early state differences with the position of the first cached step as predictors of final quality. For each combination, we use median D 10 D_{10} over the 49 prompts with stored trajectories and the same 1,632-prompt mean PSNR. We retain the 218 combinations whose first cached step occurs before state 10, so that caching has begun when the early gap is measured. Within each model and cache count K K , we standardize the first cached step, median D 10 D_{10} , and mean PSNR to zero mean and unit variance, then pool the standardized values. paragraphs.en: The geometry-based controls use derivatives of the mean normalized off-chord distance and speed along full-compute trajectories. Speed is normalized step displacement per unit change in noise level. These derivatives define costs for cached intervals, with larger costs for longer noise-level gaps since the last full step. Dynamic programming selects a schedule with the lowest total cost for each model and cache ratio. The FLUX.1-dev controls also include six schedules selected using preliminary output quality. These variants change the derivative order and how strongly the interval cost increases with the gap.
paragraphs.zh: 基于几何的控制方法使用沿全计算轨迹的平均归一化偏离弦距离和速度的导数。 速度定义为噪声水平每单位变化下的步进位移。 这些导数为缓存的区间定义代价，且距上一次完整步骤的噪声水平间隔越大，代价越高。 动态规划为每个模型和缓存比例选择总代价最低的调度方案。 FLUX.1-dev 的控制方法还包括六个使用初步输出质量选出的调度方案。 这些变体改变了导数的阶数以及区间代价随间隔增长的程度。

For residual reuse, the complete product has a correlation of 0.886, compared with 0.528 for local feature error ‖ r k ‖ \left\lVert r_{k}\right\rVert and 0.867 for the negated step index − k -k . For second-order Hermite prediction, the correlation is 0.896 for the complete product, 0.586 for ‖ r k ‖ \left\lVert r_{k}\right\rVert , and 0.880 for − k -k . For first-order Taylor prediction, it is 0.899 for the complete product, 0.676 for ‖ r k ‖ \left\lVert r_{k}\right\rVert , and 0.880 for − k -k . The sampler step size | Δ ​ τ k | |\Delta\tau_{k}| and the measured future gain change in opposite directions over denoising steps. The feature-error norm multiplied by the step size, and the next-state error estimate defined in Table 31 , are negatively correlated with output-error magnitude. paragraphs.en: We also split the 100 prompts into 50 even-indexed and 50 odd-indexed prompts. We test both transfer directions. Using the profile estimated from the other half changes the correlation between this product and output-error magnitude by less than 0.003, relative to using a profile estimated from the evaluation half. Across approximation policies, the Spearman correlation between the two halves’ propagation profiles ranges from 0.9955 to 0.9981. Thus, the propagation profile transfers across these prompt subsets. paragraphs.en: We distinguish the effects of schedule selection and feature approximation through controlled comparisons.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过受控比较来区分调度选择与特征近似的影响。

paragraphs.en: The image experiment uses four schedules: BudCache, DPCache, the uniform schedule shared by the fixed predictors, and DiCache’s most frequent schedule selected on the 544-prompt selection split. Each is evaluated with residual reuse, first-order Taylor prediction, second-order Hermite prediction, MeanCache’s interval-average velocity prediction, and two-anchor prediction in every model–ratio combination, using 1,632 PartiPrompts under three base seeds. For each of the 20 combinations, we average PSNR over prompts within each seed, then average the three seed means. An additive least-squares fit with equal weight for all 20 means separates the schedule and approximation policy effects, with each set of effects constrained to sum to zero. The interaction is the residual from this fit. Its variance share is the sum of squared residuals divided by the total sum of squared deviations of the 20 means from their grand mean. Schedule and approximation policy shares use the corresponding fitted effects and the same denominator. Table 32 reports the separate and joint effects.
paragraphs.zh: 图像实验使用四种调度：BudCache、DPCache、固定预测器共用的均匀调度，以及在 544 提示词选择集上选出的 DiCache 最高频调度。 每种调度都在所有模型–比例组合下，分别结合残差复用、一阶泰勒预测、二阶厄米特预测、MeanCache 的区间平均速度预测和双锚点预测进行评估，使用三个基础随机种子下的 1,632 条 PartiPrompts。 对这 20 个组合中的每一个，我们先计算每个种子内各提示词的 PSNR 平均值，再对三个种子的均值求平均。 采用对所有 20 个均值等权重的加性最小二乘拟合，将调度效应与近似策略效应分离，且每组效应被约束为零和。 交互项即该拟合的残差。 其方差占比为残差平方和除以 20 个均值相对其总均值的总偏差平方和。 调度与近似策略的占比则使用相应的拟合效应和同一分母。 表 32 报告了各单独效应与联合效应。

paragraphs.en: The fixed-schedule comparisons in Figure 12 evaluate the five approximation policies on BudCache schedules. FLUX.1-dev uses 1,632 PartiPrompts under three seeds. HunyuanVideo uses 300 prompts, split evenly between Penguin599 and VBench944, with one seed per prompt. The comparisons with a fixed approximation policy instead use the three-seed baseline results of Appendix A.5 . They compare fixed BudCache schedules with adaptive SeaCache schedules under residual reuse, averaging equally over four image datasets or two video datasets. Figure 13 gives this comparison for Qwen-Image and Wan2.1. The two methods’ mean PSNR differs by up to 3.2 dB on images and 3.0 dB on videos. Table 33 also compares TaylorSeer, HiCache, and L2P, which share a schedule but use different approximation policies. Its PSNR range across approximation policies is the difference between their highest and lowest mean PSNR.

paragraphs.en: To evaluate a schedule, we generate images from the eight prompt–seed examples in Table 34 . We compare each image with the full-compute output from the same prompt and seed, then average the eight PSNR values. The eight examples were fixed before any search ran. None of the eight prompts appears in DrawBench, GenEval-style, PartiPrompts, or DiffusionDB-clean10k. Repeat visits to an already scored schedule reuse its stored score and consume no additional evaluations. Initial schedules include recurring schedules selected using 544 PartiPrompts. The final PartiPrompts results include that selection set. DrawBench, GenEval-style, and DiffusionDB evaluation prompts are separate from both initialization data and candidate-scoring examples.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估某一调度方案，我们根据表 34 中的八个提示词–种子示例生成图像。 我们将每张图像与相同提示词和种子下的完整计算输出进行比较，然后对八个 PSNR 值取平均。 这八个示例在任何搜索运行之前就已固定。 这八个提示词均未出现在 DrawBench、GenEval 风格、PartiPrompts 或 DiffusionDB-clean10k 中。 对已评分调度方案的重复访问会复用其已存储的分数，且不消耗额外的评估次数。 初始调度方案包括使用 544 个 PartiPrompts 选出的循环调度方案。 最终的 PartiPrompts 结果包含该选择集。 DrawBench、GenEval 风格和 DiffusionDB 的评估提示词均与初始化数据及候选评分示例相互独立。

paragraphs.en: A swap exchanges one cached step with one full step whose position is not required by the search-space constraints. It preserves the cache count and the required full steps. Hill climbing examines the one-swap neighbors in random order and accepts the first improvement. Greedy coordinate ascent optimizes the movable full-step positions one at a time.
paragraphs.zh: 交换操作将一个缓存步骤与一个搜索空间约束不需要其位置的全步骤进行交换。 它保持缓存数量和所需全步骤的数量不变。 爬山法以随机顺序检查单次交换的邻域，并接受第一个改进。 贪心坐标上升法一次优化一个可移动的全步骤位置。

sents.en: A swap exchanges one cached step with one full step whose position is not required by the search-space constraints.
sents.zh: 交换操作将一个缓存步骤与一个搜索空间约束不需要其位置的全步骤进行交换。

sents.en: It preserves the cache count and the required full steps.
sents.zh: 它保持缓存数量和所需全步骤的数量不变。

sents.en: Hill climbing examines the one-swap neighbors in random order and accepts the first improvement.
sents.zh: 爬山法以随机顺序检查单次交换的邻域，并接受第一个改进。

sents.en: Greedy coordinate ascent optimizes the movable full-step positions one at a time.
sents.zh: 贪心坐标上升法一次优化一个可移动的全步骤位置。

paragraphs.en: Each procedure receives the same evaluation budget within a model and cache ratio: 1,400 at K = 29 K=29 , 700 at K = 37 K=37 , and 400 at K = 41 K=41 . Before search, we evaluate 25 pairs, each containing a uniformly sampled schedule and a one-swap neighbor. These 50 evaluations measure the scale of PSNR changes and count toward the budget. For annealing, we set t max t_{\max} to ten times the median absolute change across these pairs and t min t_{\min} to that median divided by 100. The temperatures are rounded to two significant figures. Table 35 gives the measured changes and temperatures.
paragraphs.zh: 在同一模型与缓存比率下，每个流程获得相同的评估预算：K=29 时为 1400 次，K=37 时为 700 次，K=41 时为 400 次。 在搜索之前，我们评估 25 对样本，每对包含一个均匀采样的调度和一个单次交换的相邻解。 这 50 次评估用于衡量 PSNR 变化的量级，并计入预算。 对于退火，我们将 t_max 设为这些配对中绝对变化中位数的十倍，将 t_min 设为该中位数除以 100。 温度四舍五入保留两位有效数字。 表 35 给出了测得的变化和温度。

sents.en: Each procedure receives the same evaluation budget within a model and cache ratio: 1,400 at K = 29 K=29 , 700 at K = 37 K=37 , and 400 at K = 41 K=41 .
sents.zh: 在同一模型与缓存比率下，每个流程获得相同的评估预算：K=29 时为 1400 次，K=37 时为 700 次，K=41 时为 400 次。

sents.en: Before search, we evaluate 25 pairs, each containing a uniformly sampled schedule and a one-swap neighbor.
sents.zh: 在搜索之前，我们评估 25 对样本，每对包含一个均匀采样的调度和一个单次交换的相邻解。

sents.en: These 50 evaluations measure the scale of PSNR changes and count toward the budget.
sents.zh: 这 50 次评估用于衡量 PSNR 变化的量级，并计入预算。

sents.en: For annealing, we set t max t_{\max} to ten times the median absolute change across these pairs and t min t_{\min} to that median divided by 100.
sents.zh: 对于退火，我们将 t_max 设为这些配对中绝对变化中位数的十倍，将 t_min 设为该中位数除以 100。

sents.en: The temperatures are rounded to two significant figures.
sents.zh: 温度四舍五入保留两位有效数字。

sents.en: Table 35 gives the measured changes and temperatures.
sents.zh: 表 35 给出了测得的变化和温度。

paragraphs.en: The schedules used to start optimization are separate from these 50 schedules. Hill climbing and annealing start from a shuffled list of six to eight schedules from BudCache, MeanCache, DPCache, uniform spacing, and the most frequent adaptive schedules that satisfy the search-space constraints. Each procedure optimizes from these schedules in turn, then uses random restarts if its budget remains. Greedy coordinate ascent starts from a random schedule.
paragraphs.zh: 用于启动优化的调度与这 50 个调度是分开的。 爬山法和退火法从 BudCache、MeanCache、DPCache、均匀间隔以及满足搜索空间约束的最频繁自适应调度中打乱后的六到八个调度组成的列表开始。 每个过程依次从这些调度开始优化，然后在其预算仍有剩余时使用随机重启。 贪心坐标上升从随机调度开始。

sents.en: The schedules used to start optimization are separate from these 50 schedules.
sents.zh: 用于启动优化的调度与这 50 个调度是分开的。

sents.en: Hill climbing and annealing start from a shuffled list of six to eight schedules from BudCache, MeanCache, DPCache, uniform spacing, and the most frequent adaptive schedules that satisfy the search-space constraints.
sents.zh: 爬山法和退火法从 BudCache、MeanCache、DPCache、均匀间隔以及满足搜索空间约束的最频繁自适应调度中打乱后的六到八个调度组成的列表开始。

sents.en: Each procedure optimizes from these schedules in turn, then uses random restarts if its budget remains.
sents.zh: 每个过程依次从这些调度开始优化，然后在其预算仍有剩余时使用随机重启。

sents.en: Greedy coordinate ascent starts from a random schedule.
sents.zh: 贪心坐标上升从随机调度开始。

paragraphs.en: An annealing proposal first selects a cached step uniformly. With probability 0.7, it exchanges that step with a movable full step at most three positions away, if one exists. Otherwise, it selects the full step uniformly from all movable full steps. Each annealing chain uses 680, 360, or 200 proposals at K = 29 , 37 , 41 K=29,37,41 , followed by up to 20 rounds of steepest improvement using swaps within three step positions. All stages are subject to the evaluation budget.
paragraphs.zh: 退火提议首先均匀地选择一个缓存的步骤。 以 0.7 的概率，如果存在距离不超过三个位置的可移动完整步骤，它就用该步骤与所选步骤进行交换。 否则，它从所有可移动的完整步骤中均匀地选择一个完整步骤。 每条退火链在 K = 29, 37, 41 时分别使用 680、360 或 200 次提议，随后进行最多 20 轮最陡改进，使用三个步骤位置范围内的交换。 所有阶段都受评估预算的约束。

sents.en: An annealing proposal first selects a cached step uniformly.
sents.zh: 退火提议首先均匀地选择一个缓存的步骤。

sents.en: With probability 0.7, it exchanges that step with a movable full step at most three positions away, if one exists.
sents.zh: 以 0.7 的概率，如果存在距离不超过三个位置的可移动完整步骤，它就用该步骤与所选步骤进行交换。

sents.en: Otherwise, it selects the full step uniformly from all movable full steps.
sents.zh: 否则，它从所有可移动的完整步骤中均匀地选择一个完整步骤。

sents.en: Each annealing chain uses 680, 360, or 200 proposals at K = 29 , 37 , 41 K=29,37,41 , followed by up to 20 rounds of steepest improvement using swaps within three step positions.
sents.zh: 每条退火链在 K = 29, 37, 41 时分别使用 680、360 或 200 次提议，随后进行最多 20 轮最陡改进，使用三个步骤位置范围内的交换。

sents.en: All stages are subject to the evaluation budget.
sents.zh: 所有阶段都受评估预算的约束。

paragraphs.en: Hill climbing also stops after two consecutive completed climbs that each improve the best mean score by less than twice its standard error. Annealing applies this rule to completed chains followed by local improvement. Greedy coordinate ascent applies it to completed coordinate sweeps. This standard error is computed from the current best schedule’s eight scores. Random search uses only the evaluation limit. All PSNR searches exhausted their evaluation budgets.
paragraphs.zh: 爬山法也会在连续两次完成的爬升各自将最佳平均分提升幅度小于其两倍标准误后停止。 模拟退火将此规则应用于已完成的链，随后进行局部改进。 贪心坐标上升法将其应用于已完成的坐标扫掠。 该标准误根据当前最佳调度的八个分数计算得出。 随机搜索仅使用评估上限。 所有 PSNR 搜索都耗尽了其评估预算。

sents.en: Hill climbing also stops after two consecutive completed climbs that each improve the best mean score by less than twice its standard error.
sents.zh: 爬山法也会在连续两次完成的爬升各自将最佳平均分提升幅度小于其两倍标准误后停止。

sents.en: Annealing applies this rule to completed chains followed by local improvement.
sents.zh: 模拟退火将此规则应用于已完成的链，随后进行局部改进。

sents.en: Greedy coordinate ascent applies it to completed coordinate sweeps.
sents.zh: 贪心坐标上升法将其应用于已完成的坐标扫掠。

sents.en: This standard error is computed from the current best schedule’s eight scores.
sents.zh: 该标准误根据当前最佳调度的八个分数计算得出。

sents.en: Random search uses only the evaluation limit.
sents.zh: 随机搜索仅使用评估上限。

sents.en: All PSNR searches exhausted their evaluation budgets.
sents.zh: 所有 PSNR 搜索都耗尽了其评估预算。

paragraphs.en: Random sampling, hill climbing, simulated annealing, and greedy coordinate ascent each retain their best three candidates that differ from one another at four or more step positions. At each such position, one schedule uses a full step and the other uses a cached step. All candidates for a model–ratio combination are re-scored on 50 separate validation prompts from COCO 2014 captions at seed 50042. To select these prompts, we order the COCO 2014 captions by annotation ID and take the first 50 after the largest ID used by the scoring examples. Each procedure selects the candidate with the highest validation mean. Identical schedules are merged across procedures. For each model–ratio combination, Section 6 reports the candidate with the highest validation mean across all four procedures. Table 36 lists the six selected schedules. Table 37 shows the eight procedure–model–ratio combinations where validation changes the candidate selected by the eight-example mean.
paragraphs.zh: 随机采样、爬山法、模拟退火和贪心坐标上升各自保留最佳三个候选，这些候选在四个或更多步位置上彼此不同。 在每个这样的位置，一个调度使用完整步，另一个使用缓存步。 对于每个模型–比例组合，所有候选都在来自 COCO 2014 图说、种子为 50042 的 50 个独立验证提示上重新打分。 为了选择这些提示，我们按标注 ID 对 COCO 2014 图说排序，并取打分示例所用最大 ID 之后的第一个 50 条。 每种程序选择验证均值最高的候选。 相同的调度在各程序之间被合并。 对于每个模型–比例组合，第 6 节报告在所有四种程序中验证均值最高的候选。 表 36 列出六个选定的调度。 表 37 展示了八个程序–模型–比例组合，其中验证改变了由八示例均值所选出的候选。

sents.en: Random sampling, hill climbing, simulated annealing, and greedy coordinate ascent each retain their best three candidates that differ from one another at four or more step positions.
sents.zh: 随机采样、爬山法、模拟退火和贪心坐标上升各自保留最佳三个候选，这些候选在四个或更多步位置上彼此不同。

sents.en: At each such position, one schedule uses a full step and the other uses a cached step.
sents.zh: 在每个这样的位置，一个调度使用完整步，另一个使用缓存步。

sents.en: All candidates for a model–ratio combination are re-scored on 50 separate validation prompts from COCO 2014 captions at seed 50042.
sents.zh: 对于每个模型–比例组合，所有候选都在来自 COCO 2014 图说、种子为 50042 的 50 个独立验证提示上重新打分。

sents.en: To select these prompts, we order the COCO 2014 captions by annotation ID and take the first 50 after the largest ID used by the scoring examples.
sents.zh: 为了选择这些提示，我们按标注 ID 对 COCO 2014 图说排序，并取打分示例所用最大 ID 之后的第一个 50 条。

sents.en: Each procedure selects the candidate with the highest validation mean.
sents.zh: 每种程序选择验证均值最高的候选。

sents.en: Identical schedules are merged across procedures.
sents.zh: 相同的调度在各程序之间被合并。

sents.en: For each model–ratio combination, Section 6 reports the candidate with the highest validation mean across all four procedures.
sents.zh: 对于每个模型–比例组合，第 6 节报告在所有四种程序中验证均值最高的候选。

sents.en: Table 36 lists the six selected schedules.
sents.zh: 表 36 列出六个选定的调度。

sents.en: Table 37 shows the eight procedure–model–ratio combinations where validation changes the candidate selected by the eight-example mean.
sents.zh: 表 37 展示了八个程序–模型–比例组合，其中验证改变了由八示例均值所选出的候选。

paragraphs.en: Section 6 compares schedules selected using PSNR and LPIPS. We also repeat hill climbing and annealing over the same eight scoring examples with the sum of standardized mean PSNR and standardized negative mean LPIPS. Standardization uses the mean and standard deviation of each metric’s eight-example average across the 50 initial schedules in that model–ratio combination. Thus the joint objective is ( PSNR − μ P ) / σ P − ( LPIPS − μ L ) / σ L ({\rm PSNR}-\mu_{P})/\sigma_{P}-({\rm LPIPS}-\mu_{L})/\sigma_{L} . Each objective uses the same 50 validation prompts and four evaluation datasets, including the full PartiPrompts set described above.
paragraphs.zh: 第 6 节比较了使用 PSNR 和 LPIPS 选择的调度方案。 我们还在相同的八个评分示例上，以标准化平均 PSNR 与标准化负平均 LPIPS 之和重复了爬山法和模拟退火法。 标准化使用每个指标在八示例上的平均值，在该模型–比例组合的 50 个初始调度方案中的均值和标准差。 因此联合目标为 ( PSNR − μ P ) / σ P − ( LPIPS − μ L ) / σ L ({\rm PSNR}-\mu_{P})/\sigma_{P}-({\rm LPIPS}-\mu_{L})/\sigma_{L}。 每个目标都使用相同的 50 个验证提示词和四个评估数据集，包括上文所述的完整 PartiPrompts 集合。

sents.en: Section 6 compares schedules selected using PSNR and LPIPS.
sents.zh: 第 6 节比较了使用 PSNR 和 LPIPS 选择的调度方案。

sents.en: We also repeat hill climbing and annealing over the same eight scoring examples with the sum of standardized mean PSNR and standardized negative mean LPIPS.
sents.zh: 我们还在相同的八个评分示例上，以标准化平均 PSNR 与标准化负平均 LPIPS 之和重复了爬山法和模拟退火法。

sents.en: Standardization uses the mean and standard deviation of each metric’s eight-example average across the 50 initial schedules in that model–ratio combination.
sents.zh: 标准化使用每个指标在八示例上的平均值，在该模型–比例组合的 50 个初始调度方案中的均值和标准差。

sents.en: Thus the joint objective is ( PSNR − μ P ) / σ P − ( LPIPS − μ L ) / σ L ({\rm PSNR}-\mu_{P})/\sigma_{P}-({\rm LPIPS}-\mu_{L})/\sigma_{L} .
sents.zh: 因此联合目标为 ( PSNR − μ P ) / σ P − ( LPIPS − μ L ) / σ L ({\rm PSNR}-\mu_{P})/\sigma_{P}-({\rm LPIPS}-\mu_{L})/\sigma_{L}。

sents.en: Each objective uses the same 50 validation prompts and four evaluation datasets, including the full PartiPrompts set described above.
sents.zh: 每个目标都使用相同的 50 个验证提示词和四个评估数据集，包括上文所述的完整 PartiPrompts 集合。

paragraphs.en: Compared with PSNR-selected schedules, schedules selected by the standardized PSNR–LPIPS objective also have higher SSIM and lower LPIPS in all 48 tests and higher PSNR in 26 of them. Changing the objective therefore changes the quality tradeoff among schedules in the same search space.
paragraphs.zh: 与按 PSNR 选择的调度方案相比，在全部 48 次测试中，由标准化 PSNR–LPIPS 目标选择的调度方案也具有更高的 SSIM 和更低的 LPIPS，并且在其中 26 次测试中具有更高的 PSNR。 因此，改变目标函数会改变同一搜索空间中各调度方案之间的质量权衡。

sents.en: Compared with PSNR-selected schedules, schedules selected by the standardized PSNR–LPIPS objective also have higher SSIM and lower LPIPS in all 48 tests and higher PSNR in 26 of them.
sents.zh: 与按 PSNR 选择的调度方案相比，在全部 48 次测试中，由标准化 PSNR–LPIPS 目标选择的调度方案也具有更高的 SSIM 和更低的 LPIPS，并且在其中 26 次测试中具有更高的 PSNR。

sents.en: Changing the objective therefore changes the quality tradeoff among schedules in the same search space.
sents.zh: 因此，改变目标函数会改变同一搜索空间中各调度方案之间的质量权衡。

paragraphs.en: We also hold each of the six PSNR-selected schedules fixed and replace residual reuse with first-order Taylor prediction, second-order Hermite prediction, interval-average velocity, or two-anchor extrapolation. Each combination is evaluated on the same four datasets and three base seeds. Interval-average velocity uses MeanCache’s average-velocity predictor with its trajectory-based correction. Two-anchor prediction uses the first transformer block to estimate an extrapolation coefficient from the two most recent full-step residuals. Two-anchor extrapolation gives the highest equal-weight mean PSNR in all six model–ratio combinations. Its gain over residual reuse is 1.672, 0.989, and 0.071 dB for FLUX.1-dev, and 1.433, 0.454, and 0.157 dB for Qwen-Image, at cache ratios 0.58, 0.74, and 0.82.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还固定六个由 PSNR 选出的调度中的每一个，并将残差复用替换为一阶泰勒预测、二阶厄米特预测、区间平均速度或双锚点外推。 每种组合都在相同的四个数据集和三个基础随机种子上进行评估。 区间平均速度使用 MeanCache 的平均速度预测器及其基于轨迹的校正。 双锚点预测使用第一个 transformer 模块，根据最近两个完整步的残差来估计一个外推系数。 双锚点外推在全部六种模型–比例组合中给出最高的等权平均 PSNR。 在缓存比例 0.58、0.74 和 0.82 下，其相对残差复用的增益对 FLUX.1-dev 分别为 1.672、0.989 和 0.071 dB，对 Qwen-Image 分别为 1.433、0.454 和 0.157 dB。

sents.zh: 每种组合都在相同的四个数据集和三个基础随机种子上进行评估。

sents.en: Its gain over residual reuse is 1.672, 0.989, and 0.071 dB for FLUX.1-dev, and 1.433, 0.454, and 0.157 dB for Qwen-Image, at cache ratios 0.58, 0.74, and 0.82.
sents.zh: 在缓存比例 0.58、0.74 和 0.82 下，其相对残差复用的增益对 FLUX.1-dev 分别为 1.672、0.989 和 0.071 dB，对 Qwen-Image 分别为 1.433、0.454 和 0.157 dB。

paragraphs.en: We compare ten search algorithms using the scores from the exhaustive FLUX.1-dev experiment at K = 41 K=41 . Looking up a schedule’s stored score counts as one evaluation. We use these comparisons to choose the four search procedures and their hyperparameters for Section 6 . At each evaluation count, we subtract the best score found so far from the highest exhaustive score of 22.746 dB and average this gap over 50 searches. Table 40 reports the results. Unseeded methods use independent random starts. Seeded variants first evaluate the fixed schedules specified by their method and then use random restarts.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 K = 41 K=41 时穷举 FLUX.1-dev 实验的分数来比较十种搜索算法。 查询一个调度已存储的分数算作一次评估。 我们利用这些比较来为第 6 节选择四种搜索过程及其超参数。 在每个评估次数处，我们用 22.746 dB 的最高穷举分数减去目前为止找到的最佳分数，并将该差距在 50 次搜索上取平均。 表 40 报告了结果。 无种子方法使用独立的随机起点。 有种子变体首先评估其方法所指定的固定调度，然后使用随机重启。

sents.en: We compare ten search algorithms using the scores from the exhaustive FLUX.1-dev experiment at K = 41 K=41 .
sents.zh: 我们使用 K = 41 K=41 时穷举 FLUX.1-dev 实验的分数来比较十种搜索算法。

sents.zh: 在每个评估次数处，我们用 22.746 dB 的最高穷举分数减去目前为止找到的最佳分数，并将该差距在 50 次搜索上取平均。

sents.en: Table 40 reports the results.
sents.zh: 表 40 报告了结果。

sents.en: Unseeded methods use independent random starts.

paragraphs.en: The exhaustive scores also show how many schedules approach the highest mean PSNR. Three schedules are within 0.01 dB of that score, 12 within 0.05 dB, 76 within 0.10 dB, and 247 within 0.20 dB. Steepest ascent from 2,000 random starts under the one-swap neighborhood converges to one of three schedules: the exhaustive best in 54.6% of climbs, a second optimum 0.0057 dB below it in 39.0%, and a third 0.26 dB below it in 6.3%.
paragraphs.zh: 穷举得分还显示了有多少个调度方案接近最高平均 PSNR。 有 3 个调度方案与该得分相差 0.01 dB 以内，12 个相差 0.05 dB 以内，76 个相差 0.10 dB 以内，247 个相差 0.20 dB 以内。 在单交换邻域下，从 2,000 个随机起点进行的最陡上升法收敛到三个调度方案之一：其中 54.6% 的爬升收敛到穷举最优解，39.0% 收敛到比其低 0.0057 dB 的第二最优解，6.3% 收敛到比其低 0.26 dB 的第三最优解。

sents.en: The exhaustive scores also show how many schedules approach the highest mean PSNR.
sents.zh: 穷举得分还显示了有多少个调度方案接近最高平均 PSNR。

sents.en: Three schedules are within 0.01 dB of that score, 12 within 0.05 dB, 76 within 0.10 dB, and 247 within 0.20 dB.
sents.zh: 有 3 个调度方案与该得分相差 0.01 dB 以内，12 个相差 0.05 dB 以内，76 个相差 0.10 dB 以内，247 个相差 0.20 dB 以内。

sents.en: Steepest ascent from 2,000 random starts under the one-swap neighborhood converges to one of three schedules: the exhaustive best in 54.6% of climbs, a second optimum 0.0057 dB below it in 39.0%, and a third 0.26 dB below it in 6.3%.
sents.zh: 在单交换邻域下，从 2,000 个随机起点进行的最陡上升法收敛到三个调度方案之一：其中 54.6% 的爬升收敛到穷举最优解，39.0% 收敛到比其低 0.0057 dB 的第二最优解，6.3% 收敛到比其低 0.26 dB 的第三最优解。

paragraphs.en: We also measure how reducing the number of scoring runs affects schedule selection. For every subset of n n of the four scoring runs, we select the schedule with the highest n n -run mean PSNR over the whole space. We then evaluate that schedule by its four-run mean PSNR. The mean loss relative to the best four-run mean is 0.315 dB over the four single-run subsets, 0.284 dB over the six two-run subsets, and 0.219 dB over the four three-run subsets. The individual subset losses run from 0.000 to 1.017 dB, showing that the choice of scoring examples affects which schedule is selected.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还测量了减少评分运行次数会如何影响调度方案的选择。 对于四次评分运行中的每个规模为 n n 的子集，我们在整个空间上选择 n n 次运行平均 PSNR 最高的调度方案。 然后我们用该调度方案的四次运行平均 PSNR 来评估它。 相对于最佳四次运行平均值，四个单次运行子集的平均损失为 0.315 dB，六个两次运行子集为 0.284 dB，四个三次运行子集为 0.219 dB。 各个子集的损失从 0.000 到 1.017 dB 不等，这表明评分样例的选择会影响最终选中哪个调度方案。

sents.en: We also measure how reducing the number of scoring runs affects schedule selection.
sents.zh: 我们还测量了减少评分运行次数会如何影响调度方案的选择。

sents.en: For every subset of n n of the four scoring runs, we select the schedule with the highest n n -run mean PSNR over the whole space.
sents.zh: 对于四次评分运行中的每个规模为 n n 的子集，我们在整个空间上选择 n n 次运行平均 PSNR 最高的调度方案。

sents.en: We then evaluate that schedule by its four-run mean PSNR.
sents.zh: 然后我们用该调度方案的四次运行平均 PSNR 来评估它。

sents.en: The mean loss relative to the best four-run mean is 0.315 dB over the four single-run subsets, 0.284 dB over the six two-run subsets, and 0.219 dB over the four three-run subsets.
sents.zh: 相对于最佳四次运行平均值，四个单次运行子集的平均损失为 0.315 dB，六个两次运行子集为 0.284 dB，四个三次运行子集为 0.219 dB。

sents.en: The individual subset losses run from 0.000 to 1.017 dB, showing that the choice of scoring examples affects which schedule is selected.
sents.zh: 各个子集的损失从 0.000 到 1.017 dB 不等，这表明评分样例的选择会影响最终选中哪个调度方案。
